author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at how in the last few days millions of people all over the world we're suddenly told to fork over their ID just to download apps or browse the Internet. A lot has happened in the last two weeks and I wanted to get it all in one place to show you what's happening and how you can try to avoid it... for now. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: THIS NIGHTMARE DOESN'T END...
